info.title: ProcrastiMate agent API
info.description: The routes an AI account may call with its `pm.<ownerId>.<secret>` token.

Priority.description: Todoist priorities: 1 is the most urgent, 4 is the unmarked default.

ShareTarget.description: What a share reaches. `id` is empty for the whole space.

SpaceView.description: What the caller sees of a space, for the agent command API.

AgentNewTask.description: A task the agent command API adds. It needs `text` or `title`.

TaskEdit.description: The editable fields of a task. A missing field is left alone; for nullable fields, `null` clears the value. A section moves the task into its project, and a new project without one leaves the task in no section.

ActivityEntry.description: One change to a task, or one run of quick edits by the same actor, read from the space’s log.

Person.description: A human, or an AI account with the human who owns it.

TaskComment.description: A comment on a task with its author, for the agent command API.

NewComment.description: A comment the agent command API adds. A blank body is refused.

NewProject.description: A project the agent command API adds or renames. A blank name is refused.

NewSection.description: A section the agent command API adds last in its project. A name the project has already returns that section.

index.description: Its new place among the project’s sections, from 0.

SectionEdit.description: Renames a section, moves it among its project’s sections, or both.

NewLabel.description: A label the agent command API adds. A name already taken, ignoring case, returns that label.

LabelEdit.description: Renames a label, recolors it, or both. Names stay unique ignoring case.

ShareView.description: A share as the owner sees it in the share sheet.

NewLink.description: A public read-only link to a task, a project, or a label. Asking again for the same target returns the same link.

post.description: The apps’ replication protocol. `{ "cursor": 0, "ops": [] }` answers with the whole visible snapshot. A task op is applied when the task is editable before and after it, a comment op when its task is editable and the comment is new or the caller’s own, and a project, section, or label op only for the owner or an AI account; other ops are acknowledged and dropped. Each op is validated on its own: one that fails is listed in `rejected` with the reason and never applies, the rest still do, and the answer is the whole snapshot.

get.description: The tasks, projects, and labels of the space, and the ids of visible tasks the caller may not edit.

post.description: `text` reads like the app’s quick add: dates, repeats, `p1` to `p4`, reminders, and `#Project` and `@label` for ones that exist. Explicit fields win over parsed ones.

patch.description: Only the fields sent change; `null` clears a nullable field.

delete.summary: Delete a task and its subtasks

post.description: A recurring task moves to its next date instead of closing.

get.description: Who created, edited, completed, reopened, or deleted the task, and when, oldest first.
`id` is the task’s. Oldest first, each with its author.

post.description: Needs the task editable. Links in `body` show as links in the apps. The caller is the author.

patch.description: `id` is the comment’s. Only its author may edit it.

delete.description: `id` is the comment’s. Only its author may delete it.

post.description: A name already taken, ignoring case, returns that project.

patch.description: `id` is the project’s. Another project’s name, ignoring case, is refused.

delete.summary: Delete a project with its sections and tasks
delete.description: `id` is the project’s. Every task in it goes too, subtasks included.

post.summary: Add a section to a project
post.description: It goes last in the project. A name the project already has, ignoring case, returns that section.

patch.description: `id` is the section’s. `index` is its new place among the project’s sections, from 0.

delete.summary: Delete a section with its tasks
delete.description: `id` is the section’s. Every task in it goes too, subtasks included.

post.description: A name already taken, ignoring case, returns that label. Without `color` it gets the app’s default for the name.

delete.description: `id` is the label’s. Its tasks stay and only lose the label.

get.description: Every read-only link the owner or an AI account made, with its `url`.

post.summary: Publish a task, project, or label as a read-only link
post.description: Anyone with `url` sees the target, its subtasks, and their projects and labels, without signing in, until the link is deleted. Asking again for the same target returns the same link.

delete.description: `id` is the link’s. Its `url` stops working at once.

get.description: `id` is an image id from a task’s `images`, and `size` is `full` (at most 2048 px on its long side) or `thumb` (320 px). Answers the JPEG or WebP bytes. An image is visible when a task you can see lists it.
